records.source: Welcome to JojaMart! How are you doing today?#$b#I don't believe we've met. I'm Morris, Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative.#$b#When you decide you want to become a Joja Member, I'll be delighted to help make your transition a joyous experience.

records.source: Welcome to JojaMart! How is your weekend going?#$b#Membership is now available!
